Description: AB-4 soil/air generator recipe, turn 6 (substitute Claude implementer). Paths are relative to the repository root; run from there.
UnscearReference: UNSCEAR 2000 Report Vol. I Annex B, Table 6 dose coefficients (citing ICRU Report 53 [I20] and Saito and Jacob, Radiat. Prot. Dosim. 58(1) 29-45 (1995) [S49])
SpectrumReference: AB-4 soil/air generator v1 (TODO-30 turn 6, substitute Claude implementer). NOT VALIDATED: awaiting the author decision on the UNSCEAR ratios (AB-4d). Field: air kerma point at 1 m above a uniform infinite soil half-space (HASL-258 Table 2 soil, 1.6 g/cm3) under infinite uniform dry air (NIST, 1.20479e-3 g/cm3), UNSCEAR 2000 Annex B Table 6 population-weighted activities K-40 420, U-238 series 33, Th-232 series 45 Bq/kg, secular equilibrium. Source: evaluated photon lines with absolute intensities only (IAEA LiveChart/ENSDF snapshots, samples/ambient/source-data/v1); see NotIncluded. Weights: scalar fluence, photons/(cm2 s). Lines: uncollided (analytic half-space kernel, MC-validated) plus the uncollided 511-keV annihilation line (MC); continuum: scattered photons (MC), uniform within each bin. EnergyZenith: zenith cosine = propagation direction . world +y (up), ground below, azimuth uniform; uncollided ground photons have mu>0. Lines and scattered photons below 10 keV are not in the file. Physics and limits: samples/evidence/results/ambient-baseline-v1-turn6.md.
